senses.sense_definition: Располагать кого-либо к себе с помощью лести, подарков или услуг.

examples.text: Он пытался <w>задабривать</w> строгого начальника мелкими подарками перед отпуском.

target_lang_translations.en: He tried to <w>placate</w> his strict boss with small gifts before his vacation.

examples.text: Не стоит постоянно <w>задабривать</w> ребенка сладостями, чтобы он вел себя хорошо.

target_lang_translations.en: You shouldn't constantly <w>appease</w> a child with sweets to make them behave well.

target_lang_definitions.en: To win someone over or make them more favorable towards you through flattery, gifts, or favors.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To make someone less angry or hostile, often by giving them what they want.
To pacify someone by acceding to their demands or offering something to avoid conflict.
To persuade someone to support or be favorable towards you.
Informal; to be extra nice to someone, usually to get a favor.
